page.title: Persona
page.purpose: Read one identity as a record: what it is, who may act as it, what it can receive, what it points at, and what it has left behind in the world.

priorities.statement: The legal basis is stated prominently and shown as immutable — this is the fact everything else depends on.
Access, channels, documents, and accounts are sections of one record, not four disconnected tools.
Document bindings show that a document exists and where it lives — never its contents, under any viewer role.
priorities.notes: There is no agent-readable read path and no operator preview; release targets a named handoff only.

priorities.statement: What is missing is as visible as what is configured, because a half-configured persona fails mid-enrolment.
Every destructive or disclosing action (revoke, release, retire) states its consequence before it is taken.

states.description: Configured, but one or more sections are incomplete — no channel bound, or no document bound.
A configured capability has stopped working: mailbox auth failing, code route unreachable, document past validity.
The viewer may see the record but not act as it; act-as controls are absent with a stated reason rather than disabled without explanation.
A retired persona, read-only, retained because the journal references it.
Retirement was attempted while linked accounts lack a recovery path; the blocking accounts are listed.
The record is cached during a dependency outage; health and binding status may lag and say so.
A persona exists but nothing is configured yet — no channel, no documents, no ACL entries. Reads as a setup checklist rather than a broken record.
